meta.title: SVTrip — What should we do today?
meta.description: Discover what to do in El Salvador: beaches, volcanoes, colonial towns and the best food. Plans for you, your family or that special date.

whatIs.title: Your travel companion for El Salvador
whatIs.body: SVTrip pairs a curated catalog of real places with a guide that gets what you are in the mood for — and builds the plan for you. No generic lists, no invented places.

testimonials.title: Travelers and businesses are already using it
testimonials.quote1: I asked for a Saturday plan for two and it built a whole route: breakfast, the beach, dinner. All places that actually exist.
testimonials.quote2: I published my business one afternoon and had people showing up from the app that same week. The dashboard makes everything clear.
testimonials.quote3: I arrived not knowing anything about the country and the guide took me to places that do not even show up in the usual travel guides.
testimonials.disclaimer: Illustrative testimonials while the SVTrip community grows.
